dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How was your first yoga class, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ wʌz jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈjoʊɡə ˌklæs, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not great. I did it very badly!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɡreɪt. aɪ ˈdɪd ɪt ˈvɛri ˈbædli!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My friend Emma does yoga very well. She moves easily and quietly.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈɛmə ˈdʌz ˈjoʊɡə ˈvɛri ˈwɛl. ʃiː ˈmuːvz ˈiːzəli ənd ˈkwaɪətli.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: She practices a lot. You should practice slowly and carefully.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈpræktɪsɪz ə ˈlɑːt. juː ʃʊd ˈpræktɪs ˈsloʊli ənd ˈkɛrfəli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Slowly? But I want to learn quickly!
dialogue.reading: ˈsloʊli? bʌt aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈlɜːrn ˈkwɪkli!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: If you do it too quickly, you can hurt your back.
dialogue.reading: ɪf juː ˈduː ɪt ˈtuː ˈkwɪkli, juː kən ˈhɜːrt jʊr ˈbæk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll do it carefully next time.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈduː ɪt ˈkɛrfəli ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm.
